thm equal_parallel_base_determinants_squared:
    ? forall u1, u2, v1, v2, w1, w2 R:
        u1 ^ 2 + u2 ^ 2 > 0
        u1 ^ 2 + u2 ^ 2 = v1 ^ 2 + v2 ^ 2
        u1 * v2 - u2 * v1 = 0
        =>:
            (u1 * w2 - u2 * w1) ^ 2 = (v1 * w2 - v2 * w1) ^ 2
    have n R+ = u1 ^ 2 + u2 ^ 2
    have cross R = u1 * v2 - u2 * v1
    have first_det R = u1 * w2 - u2 * w1
    have second_det R = v1 * w2 - v2 * w1
    cross = 0
    n = v1 ^ 2 + v2 ^ 2
    first_det ^ 2 = (u1 * w2 - u2 * w1) ^ 2
    second_det ^ 2 = (v1 * w2 - v2 * w1) ^ 2
    n * first_det ^ 2 = n * (u1 * w2 - u2 * w1) ^ 2
    n * (u1 * w2 - u2 * w1) ^ 2 = (v1 ^ 2 + v2 ^ 2) * (u1 * w2 - u2 * w1) ^ 2
    n * second_det ^ 2 = n * (v1 * w2 - v2 * w1) ^ 2
    n * (v1 * w2 - v2 * w1) ^ 2 = (u1 ^ 2 + u2 ^ 2) * (v1 * w2 - v2 * w1) ^ 2
    n * (second_det ^ 2 - first_det ^ 2) = n * second_det ^ 2 - n * first_det ^ 2 = (u1 ^ 2 + u2 ^ 2) * (v1 * w2 - v2 * w1) ^ 2 - (v1 ^ 2 + v2 ^ 2) * (u1 * w2 - u2 * w1) ^ 2 = (u1 * v2 - u2 * v1) * ((u1 * v2 - u2 * v1) * (w1 ^ 2 + w2 ^ 2) - 2 * (u1 * w2 - u2 * w1) * (v1 * w1 + v2 * w2)) = cross * (cross * (w1 ^ 2 + w2 ^ 2) - 2 * first_det * (v1 * w1 + v2 * w2)) = 0 * (0 * (w1 ^ 2 + w2 ^ 2) - 2 * first_det * (v1 * w1 + v2 * w2)) = 0
    n != 0
    second_det ^ 2 - first_det ^ 2 = n * (second_det ^ 2 - first_det ^ 2) / n = 0 / n = 0
    second_det ^ 2 = second_det ^ 2 - first_det ^ 2 + first_det ^ 2 = 0 + first_det ^ 2 = first_det ^ 2

thm proposition_38:
    ? forall a, b, c, d, f, g cart(R, R):
        $m0::f0::is_triangle(b, c, a)
        $m0::f0::is_triangle(f, g, d)
        $m0::f0::are_segments_congruent(b, c, f, g)
        m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(b, c), m0::f0::vec(b, f)) = 0
        m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(b, c), m0::f0::vec(b, g)) = 0
        m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(b, c), m0::f0::vec(a, d)) = 0
        =>:
            exist common R+ st {$f4::has_triangle_area(b, c, a, common), $f4::has_triangle_area(f, g, d, common)}
    release thm f2::triangle_vertices_distinct(b, c, a)
    by def $m0::f0::are_segments_congruent(b, c, f, g)
    have u cart(R, R) = m0::f0::vec(b, c)
    have v cart(R, R) = m0::f0::vec(f, g)
    have height cart(R, R) = m0::f0::vec(b, a)
    have lower_shift cart(R, R) = m0::f0::vec(b, f)
    have upper_shift cart(R, R) = m0::f0::vec(a, d)
    release thm m0::f0::distance_sq_positive_of_ne(b, c)
    release thm m0::f0::vec_dot_self_is_distance(b, c)
    release thm m0::f0::vec_dot_self_is_distance(f, g)
    release thm m0::f0::dot_coordinate_formula(u, u)
    release thm m0::f0::dot_coordinate_formula(v, v)
    u(1) ^ 2 + u(2) ^ 2 = u(1) * u(1) + u(2) * u(2) = m0::f0::dot(u, u) = m0::f0::distance_sq(b, c) > 0
    v(1) ^ 2 + v(2) ^ 2 = v(1) * v(1) + v(2) * v(2) = m0::f0::dot(v, v) = m0::f0::distance_sq(f, g) = m0::f0::distance_sq(b, c) = u(1) ^ 2 + u(2) ^ 2
    release thm m0::f0::vec_coordinate_formula(b, c)
    release thm m0::f0::vec_coordinate_formula(f, g)
    release thm m0::f0::vec_coordinate_formula(b, f)
    release thm m0::f0::vec_coordinate_formula(b, g)
    release thm m0::f0::vec_coordinate_formula(b, a)
    release thm m0::f0::vec_coordinate_formula(a, d)
    release thm m0::f0::vec_coordinate_formula(f, d)
    release thm m0::f0::det_coordinate_formula(u, lower_shift)
    u(1) * lower_shift(2) - u(2) * lower_shift(1) = m0::f0::det(u, lower_shift) = 0
    release thm m0::f0::det_coordinate_formula(u, upper_shift)
    u(1) * upper_shift(2) - u(2) * upper_shift(1) = m0::f0::det(u, upper_shift) = 0
    v(1) = g(1) - f(1) = (g(1) - b(1)) - (f(1) - b(1))
    v(2) = g(2) - f(2) = (g(2) - b(2)) - (f(2) - b(2))
    release thm m0::f0::det_coordinate_formula(u, m0::f0::vec(b, g))
    release thm m0::f0::det_coordinate_formula(u, v)
    m0::f0::vec(b, g)(1) = g(1) - b(1)
    m0::f0::vec(b, g)(2) = g(2) - b(2)
    lower_shift(1) = f(1) - b(1)
    lower_shift(2) = f(2) - b(2)
    m0::f0::det(u, m0::f0::vec(b, g)) = u(1) * m0::f0::vec(b, g)(2) - u(2) * m0::f0::vec(b, g)(1) = u(1) * (g(2) - b(2)) - u(2) * (g(1) - b(1))
    m0::f0::det(u, lower_shift) = u(1) * lower_shift(2) - u(2) * lower_shift(1) = u(1) * (f(2) - b(2)) - u(2) * (f(1) - b(1))
    m0::f0::det(u, m0::f0::vec(b, g)) = m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(b, c), m0::f0::vec(b, g)) = 0
    u(1) * v(2) - u(2) * v(1) = u(1) * ((g(2) - b(2)) - (f(2) - b(2))) - u(2) * ((g(1) - b(1)) - (f(1) - b(1))) = (u(1) * (g(2) - b(2)) - u(2) * (g(1) - b(1))) - (u(1) * (f(2) - b(2)) - u(2) * (f(1) - b(1))) = m0::f0::det(u, m0::f0::vec(b, g)) - m0::f0::det(u, lower_shift) = 0 - 0 = 0
    release thm equal_parallel_base_determinants_squared(u(1), u(2), v(1), v(2), lower_shift(1), lower_shift(2))
    (u(1) * lower_shift(2) - u(2) * lower_shift(1)) ^ 2 = 0 ^ 2 = 0
    (v(1) * lower_shift(2) - v(2) * lower_shift(1)) ^ 2 = (u(1) * lower_shift(2) - u(2) * lower_shift(1)) ^ 2 = 0
    by contra:
        ? v(1) * lower_shift(2) - v(2) * lower_shift(1) = 0
        v(1) * lower_shift(2) - v(2) * lower_shift(1) != 0
        (v(1) * lower_shift(2) - v(2) * lower_shift(1)) ^ 2 > 0
        impossible (v(1) * lower_shift(2) - v(2) * lower_shift(1)) ^ 2 = 0
    release thm equal_parallel_base_determinants_squared(u(1), u(2), v(1), v(2), upper_shift(1), upper_shift(2))
    (u(1) * upper_shift(2) - u(2) * upper_shift(1)) ^ 2 = 0 ^ 2 = 0
    (v(1) * upper_shift(2) - v(2) * upper_shift(1)) ^ 2 = (u(1) * upper_shift(2) - u(2) * upper_shift(1)) ^ 2 = 0
    by contra:
        ? v(1) * upper_shift(2) - v(2) * upper_shift(1) = 0
        v(1) * upper_shift(2) - v(2) * upper_shift(1) != 0
        (v(1) * upper_shift(2) - v(2) * upper_shift(1)) ^ 2 > 0
        impossible (v(1) * upper_shift(2) - v(2) * upper_shift(1)) ^ 2 = 0
    release thm equal_parallel_base_determinants_squared(u(1), u(2), v(1), v(2), height(1), height(2))
    release thm m0::f0::det_coordinate_formula(u, height)
    release thm m0::f0::det_coordinate_formula(v, height)
    m0::f0::det(v, height) ^ 2 = (v(1) * height(2) - v(2) * height(1)) ^ 2 = (u(1) * height(2) - u(2) * height(1)) ^ 2 = m0::f0::det(u, height) ^ 2
    height(1) = a(1) - b(1)
    height(2) = a(2) - b(2)
    upper_shift(1) = d(1) - a(1)
    upper_shift(2) = d(2) - a(2)
    m0::f0::vec(f, d)(1) = d(1) - f(1)
    m0::f0::vec(f, d)(2) = d(2) - f(2)
    d(1) - f(1) = (a(1) - b(1) + (d(1) - a(1))) - (f(1) - b(1)) = (height(1) + upper_shift(1)) - lower_shift(1)
    d(2) - f(2) = (a(2) - b(2) + (d(2) - a(2))) - (f(2) - b(2)) = (height(2) + upper_shift(2)) - lower_shift(2)
    release thm m0::f0::det_coordinate_formula(v, m0::f0::vec(f, d))
    m0::f0::det(v, m0::f0::vec(f, d)) = v(1) * (d(2) - f(2)) - v(2) * (d(1) - f(1)) = v(1) * ((height(2) + upper_shift(2)) - lower_shift(2)) - v(2) * ((height(1) + upper_shift(1)) - lower_shift(1)) = (v(1) * height(2) - v(2) * height(1) + (v(1) * upper_shift(2) - v(2) * upper_shift(1))) - (v(1) * lower_shift(2) - v(2) * lower_shift(1)) = (v(1) * height(2) - v(2) * height(1) + 0) - 0 = m0::f0::det(v, height)
    m0::f0::det(v, m0::f0::vec(f, d)) ^ 2 = m0::f0::det(v, height) ^ 2 = m0::f0::det(u, height) ^ 2
    have common R+ = f4::triangle_area(b, c, a)
    $f4::has_triangle_area(b, c, a, common)
    by def $f4::has_triangle_area(b, c, a, common)
    m0::f0::det(u, height) = m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(b, c), m0::f0::vec(b, a))
    m0::f0::det(u, height) ^ 2 = m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(b, c), m0::f0::vec(b, a)) ^ 2
    m0::f0::det(v, m0::f0::vec(f, d)) = m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(f, g), m0::f0::vec(f, d))
    m0::f0::det(v, m0::f0::vec(f, d)) ^ 2 = m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(f, g), m0::f0::vec(f, d)) ^ 2
    2 * common = sqrt (m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(b, c), m0::f0::vec(b, a)) ^ 2) = sqrt (m0::f0::det(u, height) ^ 2)
    2 * common = sqrt (m0::f0::det(u, height) ^ 2) = sqrt (m0::f0::det(v, m0::f0::vec(f, d)) ^ 2)
    2 * common = sqrt (m0::f0::det(v, m0::f0::vec(f, d)) ^ 2) = sqrt (m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(f, g), m0::f0::vec(f, d)) ^ 2)
    by def $f4::has_triangle_area(f, g, d, common)
    witness exist result R+ st {$f4::has_triangle_area(b, c, a, result), $f4::has_triangle_area(f, g, d, result)} from common

thm proposition_39:
    ? forall a, b, c, d cart(R, R), common R+:
        a != d
        $f4::has_triangle_area(b, c, a, common)
        $f4::has_triangle_area(b, c, d, common)
        m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(b, c), m0::f0::vec(b, a)) * m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(b, c), m0::f0::vec(b, d)) > 0
        =>:
            $f3::are_parallel_lines(b, c, a, d)
    by def $f4::has_triangle_area(b, c, a, common)
    by def $f4::has_triangle_area(b, c, d, common)
    release thm f2::triangle_vertices_distinct(b, c, a)
    have first_det R = m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(b, c), m0::f0::vec(b, a))
    have second_det R = m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(b, c), m0::f0::vec(b, d))
    sqrt (first_det ^ 2) = sqrt (m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(b, c), m0::f0::vec(b, a)) ^ 2) = 2 * common
    sqrt (second_det ^ 2) = sqrt (m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(b, c), m0::f0::vec(b, d)) ^ 2) = 2 * common
    first_det ^ 2 >= 0
    second_det ^ 2 >= 0
    sqrt (first_det ^ 2) ^ 2 = first_det ^ 2
    sqrt (second_det ^ 2) ^ 2 = second_det ^ 2
